failures.text: What is the learning budget per year?
failures.answer: The learning budget is 800 USD per calendar year for courses, books and conferences, available after probation. Since your probation is finished, this full annual amount applies to you.

Probation lasts 3 months from your start date, and it can be extended by up to 1 month only with written agreement from HR and you. Since your probation has already finished, this rule no longer applies to you.

failures.text: How do I request a new laptop?
failures.answer: As a full-time employee who has completed probation, you can request a new laptop by submitting your request through the ticket portal, since requests sent by chat or email are not tracked. Standard laptops are replaced every 3 years, and replacement of broken equipment is handled within 5 working d

failures.text: What happens to my unused vacation days at the end of the year?
failures.answer: At the end of the year, up to 5 of your unused annual leave days carry over until 31 March of the following year, and any days beyond that expire. Since your probation is already finished, the standard carry-over rule applies to you.

failures.text: Is there a maximum number of days in one annual leave request?
failures.answer: Yes, our HR policies set a limit: a single annual leave request may not exceed 10 working days. Since your probation is finished, this standard rule applies to you like any other employee.

failures.text: How do I cancel approved leave?
failures.answer: You can cancel an approved leave request before its first day by contacting HR. This applies to any approved leave, including your own as a full-time employee whose probation has finished.

failures.text: Скільки днів оплачуваної відпустки я маю на рік?
failures.answer: Згідно з нашими HR-політиками, щорічна оплачувана відпустка становить 20 робочих днів на календарний рік. Оскільки ви вже завершили випробувальний термін і працюєте на повну ставку, до вас застосовується це загальне правило. Робочі дні — це понеділок–п'ятниця, за винятком корпоративних свят.
